identity.name: Acme Ledger

tokens.--font: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans KR', -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif

notes: Brand color #4c1d95 from the site's own buttons and links becomes --brand; text on it is #ffffff (contrast 11.0:1).
The site uses Inter, one of the faces generated pages default to (TYP-01, TYP-02). Using IBM Plex instead. If Inter is part of the brand on purpose, set --font back to it and accept the finding.
Success #5bbd74 and failure #fd7468 for a dark page. Use them flat, only for real outcomes; AC-08 allows dots in exactly these colors.
Hue gap to the brand: success 144 degrees, failure 93 degrees.
Logo is set as text ("Acme Ledger"). Ask the owner for the logo file before shipping; do not invent a mark.

density.from: before.html: 48px controls (spacious), 26px card padding (airy), 17px gaps (snug), body line height 1.6 (spacious)

contrast.meaning: Standard: muted text well above 4.5:1, surfaces step by a small tone.
contrast.from: before.html: the quieter quarter of body text at 7.3:1, 1 text runs under 4.5:1

roundness.meaning: Pillow: about 20px or more on cards; full pills only on small controls.

type-expression.meaning: Poster: an expressive display face, display four times body or more, tight leading on headlines.
type-expression.from: before.html: largest text 76px at weight 800 over 14px body (5.43x)

color-restraint.meaning: Achromatic: neutral surfaces and one brand slot, semantic colors only for real outcomes.
color-restraint.from: before.html: 2 hue families (277, 354 degrees), colored fills on 87% of the page

because.principle: Type and color do not both shout: the louder the type, the fewer hues around it.

elevation.meaning: Raised: a small shadow on cards and a larger one on floating layers.
elevation.from: before.html: shadows (reach 35px) only on 2 controls or overlays, not on cards

because.principle: Large radius and deep soft shadow together are the default generated card; one of the two carries the softness.

motion.meaning: Still: state changes are instant, only opacity and color fade.
motion.from: before.html: no transitions on 2 interactive elements

stroke.meaning: Light: one pixel borders at low opacity on containers and fields.
stroke.from: before.html: 3 borders and rules, 1px at 1.32:1 against their background
